name: ACCT 5532
title: Contemporary Issues in Financial Reporting and Analysis
description: Focuses on major financial reporting issues in consideration of the current data-centric technological and analytical environment. Broad topics are derived from FASB's conceptual framework, including income determination and asset valuation. Specific topics covered include risk management, earnings management, firm valuation, investing, and corporate governance issues. Introduces tools that link non-financial metrics with financial reports, providing actionable insights for external decision makers.
requirement_description: Open only to Accounting M.S. students.
